description: This file provides database connection utilities and query execution functions for PostgreSQL using psycopg, including environment variable handling and context management.

methods.name: _build_dsn_from_env
methods.description: Builds a PostgreSQL DSN string from environment variables.

methods.name: get_conn
methods.description: Context manager that yields a psycopg connection with dict rows.

methods.name: fetch_one
methods.description: Fetches a single row as a dictionary from the database.

methods.name: fetch_all
methods.description: Fetches all rows as a list of dictionaries from the database.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) and commits.

methods.name: execute_returning_one
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement that returns a single row, raising an error if none returned.
